faq_heading: Homes near Cougar Canyon Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Cougar Canyon Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Cougar Canyon Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Cougar Canyon Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Cougar Canyon Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Seaquam Secondary (0.2 km west), Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.8 km west) and Heath Elementary (0.9 km north-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Cougar Canyon Elementary

24 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Cougar Canyon Elementary in a straight line (17 elementary, 7 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is Seaquam Secondary, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is North Delta Secondary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.8 km west), Heath Elementary (0.9 km north-west), Cougar Creek Elementary (1.3 km east), Pinewood Elementary (1.3 km south), Beaver Creek Elementary (1.5 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Sunshine Hills Elementary, 0.8 km west of Cougar Canyon Elementary.
